newsitem.title: USA: Gardner Denver to build Atlanta facility.
newsitem.headline: Gardner Denver to build Atlanta facility.

text.p: Gardner Denver Machinery Inc said Tuesday it would build a new manufacturing facility in Atlanta and transfer production of its Syracuse, N.Y., operation to Atlanta in the next nine to ten months.
Gardner Denver's Blower Division headquarters also will be relocated to the new site, the company said.
Gardner Denver said it decided to close the Syracuse operation because it would require millions of dollars to repair and update.

The site employs 150 workers and a "substantial percentage" will be offered jobs in Atlanta, said Helen Cornell, a company spokeswoman. The company obtained the facility in 1996 as part of its acquisition of NORAMPTCO Inc.
Gardner Denver said it would invest "several million dollars" in the Atlanta site, but would not disclose a more specific figure, Cornell said.
"Our market place has continued to undergo fundamental changes over the past several years," Ross Centanni, president and chief executive, said in a statement.

"In order to be competitive, we must produce our products as efficiently and economically as possible," he said. "Making the decision to close the Syracuse facility was not an easy one and we deeply regret the impact the closure will have on our employees."
